metadata.title: The Great Desert Oasis Expanse
metadata.author: Paul Peter (@asterixh)
metadata.description: A vast 5760x1080 panoramic desert world featuring golden rolling dunes, lush palm oases, crystal mountain springs, nomad traders, and patrolling dune raiders across 3 detailed geographical sectors with full character scripts.

inputs: Journey into the Great Oasis Expanse!

inputs: Welcome traveler! Cold oasis water & dates for your journey.
